Re: Claim C-1282
Our client: George Booker
Date of loss: 10-9-23
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our
client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by
telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our
client, please let us know so that we can adrdess it.
We request that you disclose the boidly injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella
or excess coverage, along with the declarations pages for each. Please also confirm whether a claim has been opened and provide
the claim number and the name of the assigned adjuster.
Your company is hereby placed on notcie to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash
camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim file
notes, and any communications with the parties or witnesses. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look
forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
